tony.text: Tony? Tell me you found something to stand on.
I did. I am furious about what it is.
Ask me when I’m standing on something I can disinfect.
Concrete. Actual concrete. I could kiss it.

sean.text: Tony, it’s moving. I haven’t agreed to any of this!
I know. Keep your balance. I’m here.
Yes. I would like that noted in my performance review.
I’m back! Tony, I’m back! Don’t let anybody flush anything!
Take a breath, Sean. You’re out.
